title: Security Center
items: Added the Security Center: Owner, Extra Owner and Trusted Admin tiers control who can change security settings, with a tier lock that is on by default
Added a global whitelist for members, roles and channels with per-system scopes
Added over 220 security settings with set, get, reset, add and remove commands in every security module
Added relaxed, balanced, strict and paranoid presets, plus settings export and import
AntiNuke now has short and hourly limits per action, restores deleted channels and roles, reverts permission escalation, and watches webhooks, vanity URL changes and bot additions
AntiRaid join gate filters each have their own action, with account-age cluster detection and a sweep of recent joins
AutoMod gained scam and IP logger link detection, caps, zalgo, emoji, duplicate and wall-of-text filters with adjustable weights
Verification has attempt limits, lockouts, cooldowns, secure captchas and a fail action
Added server lockdown, backups with restore, a threat score with Beast Mode and the securitycheck command
Fixed quarantine failing the second time a member was quarantined

Fixed reaction roles: unique and add_only modes now work, rr gate accepts off, rr create select works, posted panels update their reactions and menus, select panels can be attached, and rr post replaces the old message
Fixed custom commands: member text can no longer inject action tags, regex and case-sensitive triggers keep their case, message_edit triggers fire, tags work without a colon, and {if hasrole} works
Custom command role and moderation tags now refuse dangerous roles and protected members
Polls can close automatically with --duration or with pollend, and long options are counted correctly

Fixed alert announcements failing when a ping role was set, the ticket log error, leveling multiplier parsing, nbot errors and image checks, greeting DM fallback, AFK clearing on direct messages and the support access role check
Extra Owners can now release quarantined members, from the release command and the dashboard. Trusted Admins still cannot
AntiRaid can flag joins whose name nearly matches a staff member or a banned user, and can track invites and delete one that brought in several flagged joins
AutoMod can mirror banned words, mention limit and spam into Discord's built-in AutoMod with automod native sync
Added a warning ladder that times out, kicks or bans members who collect warnings, plus webhook message protection and a lockdown for mass-mention bursts
Backups now include bans and server settings, and can be restored automatically after an AntiNuke incident
Moderation commands now protect the owner, Extra Owners and the bot, explain when Discord refuses an action, and skip pinned messages when purging
Added massban, and role add and remove now refuse roles above you, dangerous roles (owner tier only) and quarantined members
lockdownall and unlockall now use the server lockdown, so channels are restored exactly as they were
Quarantined members lose access to moderation and security commands, and the quarantine command can no longer target members at or above your tier
Added the web verification type: members pass a check on a web page, and the bot can refuse or flag VPNs and proxies and find likely alt accounts. Only hashes of addresses are kept
Added verification webinfo to review a member's web check

fakeperm now rejects unknown nodes, @everyone, bots and quarantined members, only lets the owner tier grant administrator and management nodes, logs every grant and clears grants when a role or member is removed
Rewrote the AntiNuke, AntiRaid, AutoMod, Verification, Security and Moderation guides to match the current commands, settings and defaults
Warning ladder, role changes, fake permission grants and support access now appear in your log channels

title: Web dashboard, new site and tickets overhaul
items: Added a web dashboard with Discord sign-in, per-server settings, module search and on/off switches
Dashboard can be switched on or off per server with the dashboard command, and globally by owners
Added an audit log of every change made from the dashboard

Dashboard can now create, edit, post and delete things, not just change settings: ticket panels, giveaways, reaction roles, custom commands, alerts, leveling rewards and multipliers, and moderation actions (warn, mute, kick, ban, unban)
Dashboard can manage embeds (create, edit, copy, rename, send, delete), pick an embed for each greeting, and run 24/7 lofi radio, 24/7 voice mode and custom stations
Commands page shows one category at a time with an All tab, live search, copy buttons and expand or collapse all
Documentation now covers every system, grouped by area, with search, an on-page contents list and copy buttons on commands
Dashboard redesign with a module sidebar, overview stats, on/off/pinned filters, tabbed module pages, sortable lists and better phone layouts
Rebuilt the website with a categorised command list, docs, changelog, team, terms and privacy pages
Tickets now support multiple panels (3 free, 10 premium) and multiple staff roles (10 free, 20 premium)
Added ticket forms, priorities, claiming, subjects, per-panel transcripts, auto-close and statistics
Added NSFW role-gated channels
Ticket welcome messages now ping the opener and staff roles
Fixed a database default that failed on older SQLite versions
